channel.title: Florida Man Times
channel.description: The wildest true stories from the Sunshine State

item.title: Florida Man Steals a School Bus, Cruises Around All Day Because He Figured He Could
item.description: No kids, no route, no problem. Miami-Dade deputies say his reason was refreshingly honest.

item.title: Sugar Rush: Roommate Spat Over Coffee Sweetener Ends With a Sword and a Felony
item.description: Lee County deputies say a North Fort Myers argument about borrowed sugar got very sharp, very fast.

item.title: Beach Walk, Stolen SUV, Busted Gate, Porta-Potty: One Sanibel Man's Very Long Day
item.description: Police say the chase ended in the one place nobody wants to hide, and he left his pants behind.

item.title: Florida Woman Dials 911 Three Times Because a Bar Cut Off Her Jell-O Shots
item.description: An Ocala bar said no. She said 'emergency.' Police said 'charges.'

item.title: Welcome to Florida: New Arrivals Find an 8-Foot Gator Parked in Their Driveway
item.description: The couple had just moved to Manatee County. The gator had apparently been there longer.

item.title: Florida Woman Allegedly Tries to Pay Loofah Prices for Her Whole Target Haul
item.description: Bedding, bath stuff, groceries, all ringing up as a cheap loofah. Store staff noticed.
